Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details how to integrate AI tools into the creative strategy process to generate high-quality static ads and video concepts based on deep competitor research and specific buyer avatars, rather than generic brainstorming. modules: [MCR] topics: [creative strategy, messaging and positioning, campaign setup and tracking] tier: 2 scope_hint: core

Topics. creative strategy / Using AI as an accelerant for creative production rather than a standalone strategy. Demonstrating how to use tools (like Superscale) to scrape competitor ad libraries, analyze top-performing creatives across a specific niche (e.g., supplement gummies), and generate high-fidelity ad concepts based on proven angles. Emphasizing the importance of providing AI with deep context—such as a brand URL or a specific competitor list—to avoid generating low-quality "slop" ads. Showcasing specific ad formats generated via AI, such as the "GLP-1's New Bestie" angle, iPhone Notes format, and "60 ingredients, one gummy" layout. messaging and positioning / Shifting from the outdated strategy of building ads for broad demographic audiences to the new strategy of building ad concepts around specific customer avatars. Explaining that an "avatar + template" creates an ad concept, and that Meta's algorithm uses the messaging in the creative to automatically find the correct audience. Grouping ads strictly by avatar (e.g., separating ads targeting hair loss from ads targeting weight loss) to maintain clear messaging intent. campaign setup and tracking / Implementing a modular "pack-based" testing structure for new creatives within a prospecting campaign. Launching new ad concepts (grouped by avatar) into isolated ad sets containing 4 to 8 ads. Using a 7-day minimum budget constraint at the ad set level—set to 1x the target CPA (or a maximum of 20% of the daily budget)—to force the algorithm to spend on new creatives, before removing the minimum constraint to let the best ads scale naturally.

Look for. The primary reason most AI-generated ads fail: they lack deep context and are generated as generic slop, rather than being built upon proven competitor angles and specific customer avatars. The definition of the "new way" of Facebook ads targeting: using the ad creative and specific messaging (the avatar + template) to automatically find the audience, rather than relying on manual backend targeting. The recommended structure for testing new creatives: grouping 4 to 8 ads by avatar into a new ad set ("pack") and forcing spend using a 7-day minimum budget constraint set to 1x the target CPA.
Skip. Promotional pitches to use specific AI tools (like Superscale) or join the speaker's Facebook Ads community.
